type.description: The material used for this item, optionally using the full namespace (minecraft:<item>) or just <item>

potionContents.description: The potion and custom effects contained in this potion, splash potion, lingering potion, or tipped arrow.

recipes.description: The recipes that a player unlocks when this knowledge book is used.

potDecorations.description: The sherds applied on each face of this decorated pot. If the list has less than 4 entries, the remaining ones default to "minecraft:brick"

spreadRadius.description: How far the entity should be from another entity of the same type

sectionMinY.description: Lowest point of the section to spawn in

sectionMaxY.description: Highest point of the section to spawn in

spawnNoise.description: How many chunks the selected area should deviate from the chosen area at most

splitSize.description: The size of each 'split' we do when spawning entities, higher means more performance but less precision

spawnAttempts.description: How many times to try and spawn an entity in a chunk before giving up
